# explainshell.com now doesn't have www part

Point the `explain` helper ([[DOT-8]]) at `https://explainshell.com/...` instead of `www.explainshell.com`: the certificate served for the `www` host became invalid, so the browser opened by the helper showed a TLS warning instead of the explanation.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/187#issuecomment-5711686710
Code vs intent: `explain` interpolates `${*}` into the URL without encoding; `&`, `#`, `%`, `+` in the command break the query (the `python` encoder was removed in #277 rather than replaced).
-->
